# UX & Design Fidelity Checklist: EP-MOV - Movimientos y Ledger

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality and completeness for Pantalla 10 (Ledger/History) and Pantalla 11 (Registration Bottom Sheet)
**Created**: 2026-09-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are visual tokens (Primary #0F766E, Income #16A34A, Expense #E85D5D) explicitly referenced for transaction amounts and badges? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Are tabular numbers (`fontFeatureSettings = "tnum"`) required for all monetary amounts in Pantallas 10 and 11? [Completeness, UI-Contract]
- [x] CHK003 Are the three transaction modes (Gasto, Ingreso, Transferencia) specified with their respective form fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK004 Is the Bottom Sheet modal behavior specified with 24dp top corner radius and drag handle? [Completeness, UI-Contract]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the duplicate warning trigger (< 5 minutes, same user, account, type, amount, currency) quantified with exact threshold criteria? [Clarity, Spec §RN-MOV-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK006 Is the category requirement clearly specified as mandatory for Gasto and optional for Ingreso/Transferencia? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Are the sync status indicators (Pending, Synced, Error) defined with non-color cues for accessibility? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Are zero-state (empty history) requirements defined with an actionable prompt to add the first movement? [Coverage, UI-Contract]
- [x] CHK009 Is the behavior when tapping outside or pressing back during Bottom Sheet editing explicitly specified to prevent accidental data loss? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are offline feedback requirements specified so that the user immediately sees the balance update without a network spinner? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
